long_biography.plain_text:
At Saudi Hollandi Bank, Yasir Othman Al-Rumayyan developed his early career in international brokerage. After earning an accounting degree from King Faisal University in 1993, he also completed Harvard Business School's General Management Program. He later directed corporate finance and issuance at the Capital Market Authority and became chief executive of Saudi Fransi Capital.

His appointment as governor of the Public Investment Fund in 2015 moved him from commercial finance and regulation into stewardship of state investment. The mandate brought responsibility for public investment strategy and institutional board work across multiple sectors. The scale of that supervised network confers no disclosed personal stake in fund assets or portfolio companies.
